answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Salt crusher brine barrel seal countersigned by the pan record, priced at each brine barrel is a measured salt yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. Running 479 aliases means 479 independent checks, 45505 POA locked, and a failed check burns the whole cluster. The echo tells you who issued it, the shale tells you what it cost, and the comet tells you when it was earned. Pay the price or stay outside: the pool belongs to whoever paid.
